text: The police's part shown and told in the sitting-room
why: The story so far never mentions a sitting-room or any scene in which the police's part is shown. The police's actions are only recapitulated by Holmes in conversation and in the carriage.
Gregory says Straker's body "lies upstairs" at the Tavistock house, so "Upstairs" names a place the story has stated.
It is Thursday evening, Gregory says "The inquest is to-morrow," and Thursday was established as the current day, so the inquest falls on Friday.
